req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The violation is that test[4] ('test_delete_is_not_idempotent_second_delete_returns_404') has kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. The rule requires that negative tests use heuristic='NEG'. The fix is to change heuristic from 'STC' to 'NEG' for that test. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: DELETE returns HTTP 204 No Content
Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 Not Found
Player row is removed from the database
trace: R-PLAYER-021: system shall remove the row so GET returns 404 afterwards
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert del_resp.status_code == 204
assert del_resp.content == b''
get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert get_resp.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_is_not_idempotent_second_delete_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=15 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Assert first response status is exactly 204
Assert second response status is exactly 404
expected: First DELETE returns HTTP 204
Second DELETE returns HTTP 404 because row no longer exists
State transition: exists -> deleted -> not-found on repeat delete
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row is removed; second delete must not silently succeed
tests.executable:

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

first = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
assert first.status_code == 204
second = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
assert second.status_code == 404
get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/15')
assert get_resp.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_player_removed_from_list_endpoint
preconditions: Player with squad_number=20 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send GET /players/ and record count before deletion
Assert DELETE response status is exactly 204
Send GET /players/ and assert count decreased by exactly 1
Assert squad_number=20 is absent from the list
expected: DELETE returns HTTP 204
GET /players/ count is exactly len(before) - 1
No player with squad_number=20 appears in the list
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row removed from players table; list reflects deletion
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
before_resp = client.get('/players/')
assert before_resp.status_code == 200
before_list = before_resp.json()
before_count = len(before_list)
del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/20')
assert del_resp.status_code == 204
after_resp = client.get('/players/')
assert after_resp.status_code == 200
after_list = after_resp.json()
assert len(after_list) == before_count - 1
squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in after_list]
assert 20 not in squad_numbers

tests.name: test_delete_by_uuid_get_returns_404_after_deletion
preconditions: Player with squad_number=5 exists with known UUID in the pre-loaded fixture
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/5 to retrieve the UUID
Assert DELETE response status is exactly 204
expected: GET /players/squadnumber/5 returns 200 with a valid UUID
DELETE returns HTTP 204
Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 confirming row removal
trace: R-PLAYER-021: system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
get_before = client.get('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert get_before.status_code == 200
player_data = get_before.json()
assert 'id' in player_data or 'squadNumber' in player_data
del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert del_resp.status_code == 204
assert del_resp.content == b''
get_after = client.get('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert get_after.status_code == 404
